# Glow Up Academy

> India's premier women's transformation platform — body, mind, beauty, and wealth.

**Website**: https://glowupacademy.in
**Also known as**: TheDMK
**Founder**: Disha Methi Khandelwal — Transformation Coach, Master's in Applied Finance, 5,000+ transformation sessions
**Tagline**: Where Unstoppable Becomes Your Identity
**Audience**: Women in India seeking holistic personal transformation
**Stats**: 2,500+ women transformed, 5,000+ sessions, 95% success rate

---

## Core User Journey

1. Take the free 8-question personalization quiz at `/quiz`
2. Receive a program recommendation tailored to your goals, lifestyle, and investment level
3. Review the detailed results page at `/results/[program]`
4. Purchase via Razorpay (primary) or PayU (fallback)
5. Join your program and begin transformation

---

## Programs

| Program | Price | Type | Best For |
|---------|-------|------|----------|
| Essentials | ₹1,999/month | Subscription | Self-paced beginners needing flexibility |
| Webinar | ₹199 | One-time | First-timers who want to experience before committing |
| Circle | ₹3,499 | One-time | Community-driven women ready to commit |
| Transform Strategy Call | ₹1,999 | One-time | Women exploring the full Transform program |
| Transform | ₹1,20,000 | One-time | All-in 1:1 transformation seekers |
